print_colonist.name: Print Colonist
print_colonist.description: Synthesize a new colonist from stored biomass. Slow and costly, but the only way to grow the crew.

refine_fuel.name: Refine Fuel Cell
refine_fuel.description: Process raw biomass and ore into a fuel cell for the ship's drive.

medkit.name: Medkit
medkit.description: Emergency medical supplies. Restores health when used.

sleeping_bag.name: Sleeping Bag
sleeping_bag.description: A portable bedroll. A colonist carrying one rests properly anywhere, even with no bed.

knife.name: Knife
knife.description: A simple bladed weapon. Fast and silent.

stun_baton.name: Stun Baton
stun_baton.description: Delivers a powerful electric shock. Non-lethal at low settings.

laser_pistol.name: Laser Pistol
laser_pistol.description: A compact sidearm firing concentrated light pulses. Reliable at close range.

pistol_shield.name: Pistol Shield
pistol_shield.description: A sidearm with an integrated energy shield emitter.

flag_rifle_red.name: Flag Rifle (Red)

flag_rifle_blue.name: Flag Rifle (Blue)
flag_rifle_blue.description: Ceremonial rifle fitted with blue faction markings.

rifle.name: Rifle

shotgun.name: Shotgun
shotgun.description: Scattershot firearm. High damage at close range, poor accuracy at distance.

plasma_cutter.name: Plasma Cutter

energy_sword.name: Energy Sword
energy_sword.description: A melee weapon with an energized blade. High damage, requires skill.

autorifle.name: Auto Rifle
autorifle.description: Fully automatic ballistic rifle. High rate of fire, moderate accuracy.

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower

laser_sword.name: Laser Sword
laser_sword.description: A focused laser blade capable of cutting through most materials.

scout_feet.name: Scout Boots

marine_feet.name: Marine Boots

tactical_feet.name: Tactical Boots
